name: Iran nuclear programme
summary: IAEA chief told the Board on 18 Nov diplomacy is imperative; agency cannot verify Iran's 440kg of 60% uranium
state: IAEA Director General Grossi told the Board of Governors on 18 Nov that renewed diplomacy on Iran's programme is imperative; the agency has lost continuity of knowledge over uranium enriched up to 60% since June 2025 (Middle East Monitor). Its quarterly report says it cannot verify the status of about 440kg of 60% uranium and is concerned at Iran refusing access to the Isfahan enrichment plant (NEI Magazine, 18 Nov). No new strike on a nuclear site or NPT withdrawal was found.
for_you: No direct effect on the UK public. Follow FCDO advice for travel to Iran and the region.
rubric_hit: 60% enrichment and inspector access curtailed = Watch; no strike on nuclear sites or NPT exit

sources.title: Middle East Monitor — Return to diplomacy on Iran's nuclear programme imperative: IAEA
NEI Magazine — IAEA presses for Iran inspections

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.
drivers: Enrichment levels, IAEA access, Israeli/US military posture, snapback sanctions, talks.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
